name: 29424 · Charleston, SC
findings: ZIP 29424 (Charleston) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (71%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (89% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29424 (Charleston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
